responsibility: Defines FR30-specific RTL operand predicates used by the machine description to recognize legal operands beyond generic GCC classes. These predicates classify stack-adjust immediates, high and low hard-register subsets, callable memory operands, DImode operands and nonimmediates, and add immediates/register forms, enabling fr30.md patterns to select encodings and expansions that match FR30 addressing, register, and immediate restrictions.
